title: IREntry
description: One atomic, neutral fact in a project's Intermediate Representation. This is the source of truth every re-projected view must trace back to. Projects hold a list of IR entry ids — entries don't point back to a project.

content.description: The neutral, structured fact. Free-form on purpose — shape isn't fixed by an entry 'type', so extraction isn't forced into a rigid template.

author.description: User id of whoever last wrote this entry (overwritten on update — no contributor history). Their role is looked up via their ContextProfile at read/write time, not stored here — role is a lens, not a fact.
